thread:
elaine: PSA — noticed a subtle stream handshake linger across edge proxies for some customers. two affected tenants, intermittent, looks like client retries while proxy keeps half-open socket.

elaine: observed ~30s of socket in CLOSE_WAIT then a new handshake that still gets routed to same backend, causing duplicate session creation. quota counts jump.

mike: do we have any logs that show the sequence? idempotency token present?

elaine: yes i pulled a sample. here's the minimal flow:
```
client -> proxy (CONNECT SSE) : X-Resume-Token: abc123
proxy -> backend: create-session (token=abc123)
proxy keeps socket in CLOSE_WAIT ~30s
client retries -> proxy : new CONNECT (same token)
proxy opens new backend session while old still lingers
```

elaine: full logs have conn ids if you want, but sampling in console hides most of these traces.

sana: hmm sampling rate for streaming traces is 1%, right? that explains the invisibility. can we tag these events with `stream_handshake_linger` server-side and force-sample?

oliver: +1 for forced tags. also want to make sure console shows a per-tenant "linger-reconnect" counter rather than relying on traces. current dashboard spike looks like a latency blip.

mike: is this a proxy bug (not closing) or backend (delayed ack)?

elaine: early hypothesis: proxy's half-close handling on TLS rekey occasionally leaves socket in CLOSE_WAIT when client quickly reconnects. backend will try to recover by creating a new session even if previous not fully GC'd.

oliver: can we add a conservative dedupe window in the routing layer that treats identical resume tokens within 60s as idempotent? avoids double-charging. risk: delayed real reconnects might be swallowed.

sana: propose a two-step: 1) add `stream_handshake_linger` diagnostic tag + force-sample, 2) emit metric `resume_token_duplicate_attempt` per-tenant, 3) console alert when rate > 0.1% of sessions. rollback easy.

mike: sounds good, also want to collect `tcp_state` and `socket_age_ms` as tags for the trace when we force-sample. adds context.

elaine: i can drop a small agent patch on the proxy to set the tag and export socket state. quick change.

oliver: for UX, console should surface a new "streaming reliability" tile with dedupe rate + avg linger. maybe in the per-route section, not top-level.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy/edge-agent@rev-2b9cd -> staging (ETA ~6m). :rocket:

analytics-bot: note: sampling bump will increase trace ingestion; estimate +2.5% trace volume for 24h if forced for streaming routes.

mike: ok keep it to tenant-level forced sampling only for tenants showing >3 duplicate attempts in 10m. that gives us targeted visibility without panicking the billing dashboards.

elaine: agreed. i'll send a draft PR with the tag + metric emitters and a small README for on-call. will include instructions to flip forced sampling per-tenant in the console feature flag.

oliver: also add a console drill-down link to raw trace snippets for those forced-sampled sessions (so SRE can click-through).

sana: I'll prepare the dashboard change — will use a new timeseries and an anomaly alert. no query changes to billing metrics.

mike: thanks. short-term mitigation: implement routing dedupe window behind a runtime flag, default off. long-term: fix half-close lifecycle in proxy.

elaine: logging note: please avoid printing full resume token in traces, use token hash `sha256(token)` to preserve PII.

oliver: nice catch. add that to the PR checklist.

mike: can someone add a brief to the runbook (how to flip forced sampling + disable dedupe) so on-call can respond?

elaine: will add it. tagging @sana for dashboard follow-up.

sana: on it, will ping once dashboard is live. :white_check_mark:
